title: a place string the geocoder left is asked again by the runner's opening pass
line: a turn whose resolver the geocoder does not answer keeps the strings it left beside the catalog, whoever's they are; the next run's opening pass, before any turn and with nothing saved in the browser, asks the geocoder for them again through its cache, resolves what its answers settle, puts up a card for what they cannot, and keeps nothing more, so no person's never-answered string waits for a turn on that person
